card.title: INFANTRY REGIMENT 11
card.flavorText: The 11th Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 3rd Division of the Finnish Army during the Continuation War (1941 to 1944). In 1941 the division participated in Operation Arctic Fox which was a joint offensive by German and Finnish forces against the Soviet defenses at Salla, a municipality located in northern Finnish Lapland. Operation Arctic Fox was part of a larger operation codenamed Operation Silver Fox, which aimed to capture the port of Murmansk. Even though they managed to capture Salla, the operation did not meet its goal and it ended in November 1941 when both sides dug in at their positions. In 1944, the 3rd Division was sent to the Karelian Isthmus, engaging in Finland's defense against the Soviet Vyborg–Petrozavodsk offensive where the Soviets forces managed to capture East Karelia and southern Karelian Isthmus. After the Moscow Armistice (19 September 1944), the division fought in the Lapland War against Germany until it was disbanded in October 1944.
